first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The boxy taxi in the lower-right portion of frame 0, with a red body, light-colored roof, and white roof light, its rear facing the camera.

entities.name: longitudinal main road
entities.identification: The gray-brown multi-lane road surface extending upward in the frame between the buildings, with white arrows, dashed lines, and yellow transverse stripes near the near end.

entities.name: group of hanging signs
entities.identification: The horizontal rectangular signs extending from roadside supports over the road, including a long gray-blue sign, a small yellow sign, and the large sign along the bottom edge in frame 0.

entities.name: group of buildings in the near view
entities.identification: The buildings in the near view occupying the edges of the frame, including the dim gray building on the left and the beige building on the right.

entities.name: Vehicle F
entities.identification: Another red vehicle behind Vehicle A, with a light-colored roof and a white roof light; in frame 16, it is above the gray-blue hanging sign.

entities.name: building facades along the street
entities.identification: The narrow building facades on both sides of the road, with window panes, projecting structures, and awnings, excluding separate signs and pedestrians.

entities.name: illuminated signs along the street
entities.identification: The colored lightboxes, vertical illuminated signs, and signs with red-and-white circular patterns along the street, excluding the separately listed group of hanging signs.

entities.name: group of pedestrians on the left sidewalk
entities.identification: The multiple pedestrians near the storefronts on the left and the intersection, with blue, light-colored, and yellow clothing visible; excluding the separate pedestrian wearing white trousers and a dark vest.

entities.name: roadside sidewalk
entities.identification: The long, narrow road surface on the left side of the road, between the building facades along the street and the traffic lanes, turning and widening slightly at the intersection.

entities.name: roadside metal guardrail
entities.identification: The low, rod-like guardrail beside the edge of the traffic lane at the intersection on the left.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The separate pedestrian on the road in the lower portion of frames 15–16, wearing predominantly dark clothing and separate from the group of pedestrians on the left sidewalk.
